review_text: I love everything about these pants. The drape, quality material. Great constriction and style. The green color is great with a crisp white shirt for work or a white tee with white sneaks for work. Very happy with them!

product_name: Smith Straight Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Excellent quality and the lining will help it last. The weight is substantial but not overly warm. It seems quite breathable. I bought these in black previously so I knew size 00 would be perfect with only hemming needed (I'm 5'2'). I would not wash these by hand or in a machine since my experience with my black pair is that it will shrink.

product_name: Smith Straight Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Great versatile pant. Perfect weight fabric.

product_name: Smith Straight Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_title: This is a Straight Leg Horton
review_text:
I'm 5'6" 150# "athletic build", waist 29", hip 40", thigh 24", bust 36. 5". I ordered a size 6. 

This pant is very similar to the Horton Flare but has a straight leg. I own Horton Flare in a size 4, and I needed a size 4 for this too because the 6 was too big in the waist. I returned because of fit and the fact they were so similar to pants I already owned.

product_name: Smith Straight Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Lovely fabric. Just didn’t fit my curvy frame.

product_name: Smith Straight Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Professional looking, well-styled and easy to care for. Perfect!

product_name: Horton Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Fantastic construction and flattering fit that makes you legs look long. I'm only 5'2" so I needed to hem it, but it didn't loose the great flared shape. I love that it has lining and didn't find it too warm, which I thought might be a problem in the very warm climate I'm in. I liked it so much I bought in black too. Only gripe is the material picks up lint and pet hair easily.

product_name: Horton Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: I have been waiting for a good sale and reason to purchase the navy Horton Flare trousers. I have them in lilac or violet and love the fit. The material is lightweight and the color is right on spot. This style pant is my favorite. However, I did purchase a size bigger and will have to alter the length. Overall great material. I will have these for years.

product_name: Horton Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: I took a chance on these and will keep them because I like the feel of the knit suiting and i like the look of the full suit in plaid. The high rise feels good. That being said, I had to size down and will still have to get the waist taken in. I'm a true US4, and went with US2 in the hortons.

product_name: Horton Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text:
Material is amazing and flow of the leg. Flare was nice as well and feel against skin. 
Bought the last larger size - 14. But it’s quite big on me. May alter or have to return.

product_name: Horton Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Awesome

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
I love these pants, there aren’t very many styles I can wear without alterations but the Tessa is luckily one of those that fits just right. 
I love the fabric as well, it’s soft and beautiful and washable and the color is absolutely amazing.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love these trousers! I bought the Rina Sculptural Pant to go with the Rossi Executive Blazer, but I like these pants with the suit jacket even better. I have an athletic/lanky build and these fit perfectly. Material is gorgeous and I received many compliments on the color.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the length and the color. These are my new faves!

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great color and feel. They fit perfectly but I didn’t like how the pockets seemed to bulge, even tho they were not tight. I did size up as recommended. They went back sadly.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Wanted to love these pants, but they have pockets on the hips. I have hips. Pockets on the hips always stick out on me. I ordered a size larger, but despite being extremely loose, the pockets still stuck out. I can't justify the additional $80 in tailoring to get the pockets sewn shut and to hem them to a manageable length.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: A great piece to add to your collection! The fit and fabric are beautiful - the feel and weight are luxe. My normal size fit perfectly. I've worn the culotte casually with flats and a sweater and dressier with heels and a blazer. I felt confident and professional, and very up to date. The MML clothes in my closet never fail me - I can always count on looking sharp!

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: These pants are exceptional. The waist is comfortable but polished. The feel is lightweight yet substantial. The look can transition from work with the matching blazer to more casual wear with a tee and sweatshirt. I find myself enjoying this style with the Para pullover. The care (machine washable) is awesome. The feel is lightweight yet substantial.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: These pants are amazing. They are comfortable and chic and feel so soft and non-constricting. I can dress them up and down and look all out together.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Usually Travel items from other brands get pilling between the thighs and these don't do that. They were super comfy for a series of flights and could we reworn later in the trip with tennis shoes or flats, Happy with the color. Super versatile without being boring black.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love these pants and how easy they are to put on and style for work. Now need them in multiple colors.

product_name: Milo Wide-Leg Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Saddle
review_text: Excellent fit and fabric.

product_name: Milo Wide-Leg Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Saddle
review_text:
My favorite new pants.
Style and comfort

product_name: Milo Wide-Leg Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Saddle
review_text: Move this. Classy, comfortable, deep black, and pockets!

product_name: Milo Wide-Leg Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Saddle
review_text: These jeans fit beautifully at the waist and hips. The length at 30” is fine for wearing with flats. Shortened with the snaps to 28”, just above the anklebone, fine for sandals, etc. They are too short to be worn with heels. I am 5’8”, size 16. The fabric is comfortable and washes beautifully. Because they are not distressed (thank goodness!) they are fine for slightly dressier occasions. Would love to see them in more colors. On another topic, please make tops in fresh white, not just ivory. I have a cool complexion and ivory doesn’t suit me. I would love to purchase tops, so I’m hoping for white.

product_name: Milo Wide-Leg Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Saddle
review_text: These pants are staples. They look great for casual office days and weekends.

product_name: Bia Pleated Trouser - Air Twill :: Macaroon
review_text: Fantastic pants! True to size and love the wide leg style with the draping of this fabrication.

product_name: Harrison Wide Pleated Jean - Better Than Denim :: Black
review_text: Great idea, but I wasn't sure about the execution. It could be that the cut of the pants wasn't right for my body type, however. I wasn't sure if these were meant to be worn low on the waist or higher up. Either way, I couldn't get the pleats to lay flat. I am a standard hourglass and always wear a size 4 in the Milos. I don't know if sizing up would have helped.

product_name: Adler Stretch Culotte - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Very comfortable and looks smart!

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Holy grail pants. They look like professional pants but feel like sweatpants. The waist is incredibly comfortable and the sleek fabric and seams look great. I have them in three colors now and hope there will be more colors made (or some patterns, perhaps?).

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: The pants are stylish and very comfortable!

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Love the color but the pant is shorter than I expected (I am 5-3) and I probably should have sized down. When I wear them all day, they start to sag down even though they are stretchy fabric and should be comfortably tight and stretchy.

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I love the Allyn pant and the electric blue is a nice change from black. Even my husband likes the color! The fit is perfect - like yoga pants but elevated. And wearable for 3 seasons in New England. Nice improvement from the earlier roll down waist band issues.

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Super comfy and love pairing these with other tops in my wardrobe!

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Wow! The Hart pants are as comfortable as yoga pants, but retain its shape and are professional for work. At 5’3” height, they fit perfectly with 2-3” heels. Hope MM makes them in more colors.

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I had to get these pants when I saw how they gave the model legs for days - who doesn't want that silhouette?? - and I was not disappointed. The ponte fabric is thick and flattering but breathable. These are like yoga pants but for the office. LOVE! MM is really stepping up their pants game lately and I am here for it.

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_title: Beautiful material, flattering fit, comfortable, but SO LONG!
review_text: Really, really liked these pants. I even ordered them twice (and returned them twice). Beautiful material and very flattering fit. I'm 5'1" and usually have to hem, but these pants seem even longer than usual. They just aren't special enough to justify the additional $50. 00 for hemming. For a tall person (wearing heels), fabulous pants!!

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: True to size and the most comfortable travel pants EVER

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I love these pants! The fit is perfect, the length is great and I hope they make them in blue someday!

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: I love these pants. Combined with the Bluebell Rossi jacket, this is my new power suit. I get compliments every time I wear it. The pants are very long. I’m 5’ 7’’ and I had to have a good 3 to 4 inches hemmed. However, once I got them to the right length, they are perfect and this is the outfit I wear on the days I need the most confidence.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: Great fabric and color, and the fit is really good too. They arrived excessively long, so I have to pay to get them hemmed, and I'm on the tall side (5' 6"), so that was a little disappointed. Note that these are really big and flowy, so if you don't like that look, don't buy them.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: These are beautiful but they run small to MM sizing. I have 2 pairs of the Bia pants in size 4 and wear them very regularly and I also have the Milo jeans in size 4 (though I sometimes wish I had sized those up to a 6 for a bit looser fit). These I ordered up to a 6 and they were way too small. I returned for an 8 and they fit nicely now . So they are beautiful but run 2 sizes small. I also had to size up to an 8 in the matching Moreland Travel jacket and I am actually usually smaller on top than bottom. Always a Small or 2-4 in tops. It is great to have pants like the Bia and these in longer inseams though. These are just perfect for me at 5'9" and 138 lbs.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text:
These trousers have a great style. The fabric hangs nicely and they are truly wash and wear. My skepticism turned to belief. Like all MM LaFleur clothes, the quality is high and the fabric lovely. I'm going to travel in these without worrying about wrinkles and washing.
The length is slightly long for my frame, so great for those gals with longer legs. We can always hem pants, but it is really hard to make them longer! The 8 is a perfect fit for my usually size 8 body.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: Great & lightweight!

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Gorgeous pant with a slimmer fit through the thighs and subtle flare at the bottom. The ginger is a fabulous, fun color. I sized up for a more fluid fit, but could have gone with my regular MM pants size.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I bought this suit for a big speaking event, and got a slew of complements. Color is fabulous, and I love the details like the snaps on the pants that allow you to adjust length without hemming. I don’t usually wear a jacket cut so long, given that I’m short, but worked well.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Needed a black straight leg pant that could do double duty between business casual and evening glam and this pant with the crepe fabric and top stitching suits both perfectly. Fits well, true to size, length adjustable for shoe height variable, will travel well because wrinkle resistant. Wish it were available in cream or egg shell for spring/summer. Very chic but also comfy.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Best Suit Ever!!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Comfortable and flattering!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Best work pant I've ever tried!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_title: Size up if you have muscles in your legs.
review_text:
I'm 5'6" 150# "athletic build"; waist 29", hip 40", thigh 24", bust 36. 5". I ordered a size 6 and 8.

I couldn't even get my thigh into a size 6, so I ended up with the size 8. The fabric is good quality but not very stretchy, although I like the bit of structure. It is just wild to me that my MM pant size ranges from a 4 to an 8. What gives with your pattern blocks? 

Anyways, this pant does amazing things for my waist, legs and rear and is very comfortable. It is going in the rotation!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Love these! Was hesitant about the kick flare for a while but glad I tried it! It’s nice but not too pronounced. A nice change from my regular fosters and great fit as always. Wear a 2 in these as in other fosters.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Another winner and quickly has become my new favorite pants. Comfortable and easy to care for (machine wash, air dry), and continues to look neat and polished.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I bought this pant in both black and bone because it's so flattering. Love the side zip. The fabric moves with you yet holds its shape, no baggy knees. Can be casual or dressy. Love that length can be shortened with ease. Hope dark navy gets restocked in my size because will buy that in a heart beat! Had to go up one size but didnt mind that for the perfect fit everywhere else. If you like the look of a slim pant, check out this piece.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: These are my favorite dress pants! I have 5 pairs in 3 colors (black, navy, and olive green). They’re stretchy enough to be comfortable and (accommodate fluctuations in weigh), but structured and sleek enough for the office. The fabric is breathable in the summer. Tried on pairs in lighter colors but returned - fabric is too lightweight - can see panty lines underneath. Love the side-panel zipper with the little buttons - very secure.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Super practical for biz casual

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I really like the fit of the Foster cigarette pants. For me, I am usually a size 6 pants and in these, went with 8. I kept the black, returned the navy for store credit, because have so many navy pants.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text:
Love the fabric and the look suzed up 2 sizes 😜 anxious to wear them on an international flight.
Helps me look professional and fresh.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Love these so much and am very grateful I picked up a backup pair because I somehow lost my first pair and they’re sold out! These are the ones I reach for over and over again - even more than Milo’s!!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: The Daria Jeans are the BEST. Because the fabric is stretchy, the high waist does not feel suffocating like other high waisted jeans. The short pant leg is also super flattering and easy to make look casual with sneakers or nicer with a short heal. My one complaint is that these jeans don't have the built in hem button as some MM Lafleur pants -- I'm 5' 4" and I need to "hem" to make the rise hit above my ankles -- but I found that a simple fold holds all day. I could probably iron them and make the fold last through washes, but who likes to iron, you know? I also LOVE the white color -- fair warning, you need skin colored undies underneath to avoid the weird flash of pink flowers or something. I will probably purchase these in other colors.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I tried these on and immediately ordered the white pair. I wore them on repeat during a recent trip - they fit well, don’t stretch out, and have deep pockets. I also love the length: they show just enough ankle when worn with sneakers or flats, which is perfect for my 5'6" frame.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: So happy with these jeans. I have tried the Hockley, Sammataro, and Milo and this is the best fit for me. I am 28 waist, 38 hips (126 lbs, 5 ft 5) and the Daria size 4 is perfect for my shape. I wear the Sammataro in 4, it fits more like a legging. Hockley in 4 the waist was too big. Milo in 4 was too slim/straight through the hips. Daria is super comfortable and can be dressed up or down. Highly recommend for the curvy gals!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I can't stop wearing them. :)

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These are great pants—high quality and stylish. I didn't end up keeping them because the legs were as wide leg in the thigh area as I would have hoped. Perhaps the style is supposed to be fit more snugly in the thigh but I was looking for a wide leg-fitting ponte pant because I prefer my clothing to be looser fitting.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I’ll be heartbroken if MM doesn’t continue making these in other styles and colors. I wore them twice the first week. First pair of pants in this fabric that ACTUALLY look professional and don’t just say they’re going to. 10/10

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These are the best pants. They look good and are comfortable. I have been searching high and low for good pants as it seems others are now so cheaply made that they are junk. I am 5'10" and a size 8/M and usually buy tall sizes. These are barely long enough with flats, which is an accomplishment, but I will probably let down the hem and make them an inch or so longer. these could probably be lengthened to a 36" inseam.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Draping of dress pants, comfort of sweats. These will now be my go-to for work travel. Hot matching jacket for a coordinated modern suit look. Love it.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Exchanged for a smaller size. The material is nice and thick and drapes well. Please make pants in short lengths!

product_name: Mejia Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: I won’t know until I wear it, but I chose it for the fabric and the styling. I assume it will be great.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Absolutely in love with these pants! The fit is impeccable—tailored but comfortable. I don’t believe there’s a more flattering pair of trousers out there.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Comfortable and on trend - even for petites

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: I normally wear a size 2 in MMLaFleur pants. The size 2 on these pants was way too big (I would have guessed they were a size 4 or 6). I would have exchanged for a 0 but it's out of stock.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: I was worried that these would dwarf me as I’m 5’3. I did have to have them hemmed but they are one of my favorite pair of pants. I love the silhouette!

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Beautiful trousers, with a dramatic shape. Unfortunately, the faced waistband does not work well for me, so I returned them.

product_name: Tali Breeze Cardigan - Tape Yarn  :: Tan
review_text: I love this cardigan. It’s perfect for layering and has a light airy feel. My only feedback is the length compared to the shell- untucked together to proportions look slightly off. It still a keeper. TTS for me.

product_name: Teddy Breeze Jacket - Summer Pinstripe :: Navy/Ivory
review_text: Gorgeous fabric and perfect for adding a bit of polish to outfits in humid summer weather. I took my regular size for an intentionally oversized, breezy fit, but could have easily sized down one or two sizes.

product_name: Zosia Cardigan - Crochet Knit :: Black
review_text: I love this cardigan. The knit pattern detail is so lovely and the color is a rich, deep black. Fits TTS for me. The black is heavier weight than the ivory. I wear it in place of a blazer in the office and it looks amazing with jeans too.

product_name: Zosia Cardigan - Crochet Knit :: Black
review_text:
A very special cardi! Gorgeous… and they just brought it back in Black, for Spring /Summer 2025! 
It does run a tad small, sized up at my stylist’s recommendation.

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: I always seem to need a jacket to fly and this jacket was SO versatile. It looked great with black and gray slacks as well as my Filomina blouse in white!!

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fits perfectly and works right into the rotation easy to dress up or down. Looks polished as a suit and easy with jeans and separates

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: Great smart jacket! Goes with everything!!

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: So happy with this—a little long but lovely

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: Great jacket, fantastic color, but this chino fabric was just too rigid for me as I like a drapier blazer. I ultimately returned this because what I really want is a chocolate brown Yiyan. I was hoping this would be an acceptable substitute, but no. I took my smaller MM size in this one.

product_name: Athena Jetset Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this jacket as part of the suit (with the Lowen Jetset Pants) and I love both pieces. The color is beautiful, a touch more rust-toned in person, as opposed to a bright orange. The fit is close to the body and streamlined, but not tight (fabric is slightly stretchy). I wore it on a short commuter flight heading to a court appearance, and to court. It was super comfortable, did not wrinkle, and I received no less than five compliments. It fits true to size (I'm size 12, with a curvy/athletic build). At 5' 8", the pants are the right length for me to wear with flats or heels, which is ideal if you want to wear the suit when you are traveling. More colors in both the jacket and pants, please!

product_name: Cody Boyfriend Jardigan :: Black
review_text: Love this version of the Jardigan. Fit is fantastic and the button ensures that I have belly coverage and the Jardigan does not flap open in the breeze. So flattering. I've tried the Jardigan in all shapes and forms. None of the previous ones really worked for me, but this one does!

product_name: Cody Boyfriend Jardigan :: Black
review_text: It looks and feels great. Only complaint, the fabric is a bit heavy / slippery and the double breast buttons come undone often. The buttons need to be larger/have a rubbery edge or finish.

product_name: Cody Boyfriend Jardigan :: Black
review_text: Love it! Structured and comfortable!

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash
review_text: Chic and good fit.

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: I do like the blazer. Wore it to an official business event paired with a skirt. It was a hot and hit day but the blazer was comfortable. I likest he versatility of it and it wears comfortably

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: This suit ended up being more informal than anticipated. It is fine for the day of travel to sit on a plane or train, but isn’t appropriate for a business meeting. The jacket is probably better with a dress than with the accompanying pants.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Love MM always…and this suit is perfect for everyday and especially for travel! Just wore to a conference, and just did a quick iron job on it before wearing it and I was good to go! Love it super comfy and I feel like a star in it!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Love this suit. I get so many compliments when I wear it. The fit is perfect.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: love it- great fit! right weight

product_name: Yiyan Classic Blazer - Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: Perfect jacket! Great fabric!

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: First and second purchase was the blazer and matching pants. Absolutely beautiful and well made. On to my next purchase…. .

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_title: Perfect jacket to grab and go
review_text: Love the length works great over slimmer skirts and pants.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This is my second Aniya because I’ve discovered the value of having a cropped jacket with great lines in my rotation, especially with dresses and high waisted pants. The measurements are a bit different than the first iteration and I’m pleasantly surprised that it still works just fine on my long-ish torso. product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved the color and the fabric. However, the shoulder pads made me look like a line backer. I returned it.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Minor alterations needed as shoulders are too padded/wide and sleeves too long for petite frame but Bluebell color is gorgeous and length is great. Love the cloth buttons. Bought the pants to make a suit and it will be a great outfit for spring and summer.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Gorgeous jacket! The color and craftsmanship are even better in person. It is true to size and exceptionally flattering.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Needs a good steam and the sleeves shortened, but otherwise beautiful color and good fit

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the fabric and fit of this shirt. Looks professional, but is very comfortable. Color is fantastic. Runs very large. I ordered a size smaller than my normal.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved color and jacket. Returned for smaller size, much too big and hoping for right fit.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This Shacket style is a sleeper hit and a perfect addition to my power casual wardrobe. The wool is substantial yet refined, not too thick. I love wearing it as an easy layer over other tops for both warmth and style. It runs large, so went with a small rather than my usual medium. The color is absolutely gorgeous l, complements many others and will play well for most seasons. Perfect for 60 degree weather.

product_name: Ayla Travel Jacket - OrigamiTech :: Olive

review_text: I have several OrigamiTech pants and jackets and I love them for traveling and everyday. The berry jam pants, which I purchased on final sale, are gorgeous. The color is much richer than shown - so versatile with taupe, black, navy. Another addition to my growing collection.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Bought this as a Christmas gift for daughter. I can't review at this time.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Is it a dress? A coat? A jacket? Yes
review_text: I got the maroon in size 2. I usually wear 2 or 4 in dresses. Fabric has a bit of give and ample allowance of the backside when belted. I like the formality and timeless structure and always in market for dresses with sleeves. A keeper. Might even pick up in another color.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: A lovely dress--so well made--and fit perfectly. Great length for me (5'5")

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love a wrinkle-resistant, multi-tasking garment for travel and this is perfect! I was on the fence between the new, longer version and this one but went with Olive since I wanted something that can go with black or navy for travel. As with everything MM LaFleur, the quality is beautiful. The fabric is the perfect thickness, not so thick that it makes you look bulky with it buttoned as a dress, but thick enough to work as a jacket. Very comfortable and not too short for me to wear without tights. This will work for a business event and also for daytime over a t-shirt and jeans. Tailored without being uncomfortable to raise my arms. I am 5'3" usually take a 6 or 8 in MM LaFleur, purchased a 6.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love the idea of a 2 in 1 piece and it being easy for travel and packing. The bummer- the arm length is a bit short for me and the next size up was huge. Unfortunately both sizes arrived super wrinkled. Seems contradictory to the design.

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: This is my first Mazaa in the Origami Tech fabric, and I love how comfortable this dress is. I wish there would be more colors. Please make the Mazaa also in Prussian Blue!

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Professional and comfortable dress. Great length just above knee (5’5”). Love the stretch, the pockets and that it is machine washable. I have two of the Maaza dresses and one Lancia dress. I’ve switched my entire work wardrobe to Origami Tech.

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Very elegant and flattering style, quality fabric.

product_name: Artemis Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: The fabric is essentially athletic fabric in the best way: a much cooler & more comfortable dress for summer that would also work for other seasons. It has some stretch and fits my shoulders and arms (often a struggle).

product_name: Artemis Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Gorgeous dress! I love the overall styling and the sleeves. The origami tech fabric is always fabulous and it works especially well for this dress. It’s TTS for me - I took my usual size 6.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love this dress. I’m 5’10” and it hits at mid calf. The fabric is smooth and lightweight and the color is lovely. I know I’ll get a lot of wear out of this piece!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I expected a better quality in fabric. I was disappointed but noticed that the dress was well made.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Good fit. Beautiful color

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I’m 5’9” 150 lbs (ordered size 6) and love the length of this dress, feels professional and elegant. The linen is great for warm summer commutes to the office. The plaque of fabric inside the dress where the buttons stopped kept getting caught on my knees when I walked, which was annoying, so had a tailor tack it down along with taking in the bust a bit. Overall a good dress to pick up in sale

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: High quality product, love the neckline and the ability to wear open or buttoned. However, it runs really small in the bust. Tried two different sizes, and still didn't fit, and the second size was too large in the waist/hips. If you are larger busted, not the item for you. But didn't want to ding it too hard since it is a lovely piece, just didn't fit me

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This is my second Aniya because I’ve discovered the value of having a cropped jacket with great lines in my rotation, especially with dresses and high waisted pants. The measurements are a bit different than the first iteration and I’m pleasantly surprised that it still works just fine on my long-ish torso. The black/white crosshatch is a nice neutral that I can pair with navy or black. It’s that classic style that reminds me of (in a very good way) of my grandmother’s stylish outfits.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved the color and the fabric. However, the shoulder pads made me look like a line backer. I returned it.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Minor alterations needed as shoulders are too padded/wide and sleeves too long for petite frame but Bluebell color is gorgeous and length is great. Love the cloth buttons. Bought the pants to make a suit and it will be a great outfit for spring and summer.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Gorgeous jacket! The color and craftsmanship are even better in person. It is true to size and exceptionally flattering.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Needs a good steam and the sleeves shortened, but otherwise beautiful color and good fit

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love these pants. Combined with the Bluebell Rossi jacket, this is my new power suit. I get compliments every time I wear it. The pants are very long. I’m 5’ 7’’ and I had to have a good 3 to 4 inches hemmed. However, once I got them to the right length, they are perfect and this is the outfit I wear on the days I need the most confidence.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great fabric and color, and the fit is really good too. They arrived excessively long, so I have to pay to get them hemmed, and I'm on the tall side (5' 6"), so that was a little disappointed. Note that these are really big and flowy, so if you don't like that look, don't buy them.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: These are beautiful but they run small to MM sizing. I have 2 pairs of the Bia pants in size 4 and wear them very regularly and I also have the Milo jeans in size 4 (though I sometimes wish I had sized those up to a 6 for a bit looser fit). These I ordered up to a 6 and they were way too small. I returned for an 8 and they fit nicely now . So they are beautiful but run 2 sizes small. I also had to size up to an 8 in the matching Moreland Travel jacket and I am actually usually smaller on top than bottom. Always a Small or 2-4 in tops. It is great to have pants like the Bia and these in longer inseams though. These are just perfect for me at 5'9" and 138 lbs.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
These trousers have a great style. The fabric hangs nicely and they are truly wash and wear. My skepticism turned to belief. Like all MM LaFleur clothes, the quality is high and the fabric lovely. I'm going to travel in these without worrying about wrinkles and washing.
The length is slightly long for my frame, so great for those gals with longer legs. We can always hem pants, but it is really hard to make them longer! The 8 is a perfect fit for my usually size 8 body.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great & lightweight!

product_name: Bronny Cummerbund Trouser - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fantastic style, but definitely order a size (or two!) up.

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: I always seem to need a jacket to fly and this jacket was SO versatile. It looked great with black and gray slacks as well as my Filomina blouse in white!!

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fits perfectly and works right into the rotation easy to dress up or down. Looks polished as a suit and easy with jeans and separates

product_name: Athena Jetset Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this jacket as part of the suit (with the Lowen Jetset Pants) and I love both pieces. The color is beautiful, a touch more rust-toned in person, as opposed to a bright orange. The fit is close to the body and streamlined, but not tight (fabric is slightly stretchy). I wore it on a short commuter flight heading to a court appearance, and to court. It was super comfortable, did not wrinkle, and I received no less than five compliments. It fits true to size (I'm size 12, with a curvy/athletic build). At 5' 8", the pants are the right length for me to wear with flats or heels, which is ideal if you want to wear the suit when you are traveling. More colors in both the jacket and pants, please!

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Gorgeous pant with a slimmer fit through the thighs and subtle flare at the bottom. The ginger is a fabulous, fun color. I sized up for a more fluid fit, but could have gone with my regular MM pants size.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this suit for a big speaking event, and got a slew of complements. Color is fabulous, and I love the details like the snaps on the pants that allow you to adjust length without hemming. I don’t usually wear a jacket cut so long, given that I’m short, but worked well.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Needed a black straight leg pant that could do double duty between business casual and evening glam and this pant with the crepe fabric and top stitching suits both perfectly. Fits well, true to size, length adjustable for shoe height variable, will travel well because wrinkle resistant. Wish it were available in cream or egg shell for spring/summer. Very chic but also comfy.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Best Suit Ever!!

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: First and second purchase was the blazer and matching pants. Absolutely beautiful and well made. On to my next purchase…. .

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_title: Perfect jacket to grab and go
review_text: Love the length works great over slimmer skirts and pants.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the fabric and fit of this shirt. Looks professional, but is very comfortable. Color is fantastic. Runs very large. I ordered a size smaller than my normal.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved color and jacket. Returned for smaller size, much too big and hoping for right fit.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This Shacket style is a sleeper hit and a perfect addition to my power casual wardrobe. The wool is substantial yet refined, not too thick. I love wearing it as an easy layer over other tops for both warmth and style. It runs large, so went with a small rather than my usual medium. The color is absolutely gorgeous l, complements many others and will play well for most seasons. Perfect for 60 degree weather.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
I love these pants, there aren’t very many styles I can wear without alterations but the Tessa is luckily one of those that fits just right. 
I love the fabric as well, it’s soft and beautiful and washable and the color is absolutely amazing.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love these trousers! I bought the Rina Sculptural Pant to go with the Rossi Executive Blazer, but I like these pants with the suit jacket even better. I have an athletic/lanky build and these fit perfectly. Material is gorgeous and I received many compliments on the color.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the length and the color. These are my new faves!

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great color and feel. They fit perfectly but I didn’t like how the pockets seemed to bulge, even tho they were not tight. I did size up as recommended. They went back sadly.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Wanted to love these pants, but they have pockets on the hips. I have hips. Pockets on the hips always stick out on me. I ordered a size larger, but despite being extremely loose, the pockets still stuck out. I can't justify the additional $80 in tailoring to get the pockets sewn shut and to hem them to a manageable length.

product_name: Bia Pleated Trouser - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Fantastic pants! True to size and love the wide leg style with the draping of this fabrication.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: The quality of the blazer is great. The sizing is large. In retrospect, I should've exchanged it for a smaller size. I am 5'7" and 145lbs, athletic build. The size 6 on me is BIG. I recommend sizing down.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love it. I’ve been wearing it every office day since I got it. Crushed my presentation to c-suite in it

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I really liked this blazer. I got a ten and it draped beautifully, not to tight. HOWEVER, I wanted to use it as part of a suit and there were not any matching pants that I could find

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Nice and light-weight. The fit is definitely on the boxy side. Looks good with the pants and the dress.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: A great piece to add to your collection! The fit and fabric are beautiful - the feel and weight are luxe. My normal size fit perfectly. I've worn the culotte casually with flats and a sweater and dressier with heels and a blazer. I felt confident and professional, and very up to date. The MML clothes in my closet never fail me - I can always count on looking sharp!

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: These pants are exceptional. The waist is comfortable but polished. The feel is lightweight yet substantial. The look can transition from work with the matching blazer to more casual wear with a tee and sweatshirt. I find myself enjoying this style with the Para pullover. The care (machine washable) is awesome. The feel is lightweight yet substantial.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: These pants are amazing. They are comfortable and chic and feel so soft and non-constricting. I can dress them up and down and look all out together.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Usually Travel items from other brands get pilling between the thighs and these don't do that. They were super comfy for a series of flights and could we reworn later in the trip with tennis shoes or flats, Happy with the color. Super versatile without being boring black.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Love these pants and how easy they are to put on and style for work. Now need them in multiple colors.

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I love this dress. It's elegant and classy. I am 5'7" and 145lbs. I ordered the 8 and it fits, but I think I probably could've sized down with no issues. Basically, it runs a little big, but not so big that I am swimming in it.

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love, love, love this dress!

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: The lines, oh my. Simply a stunner of a dress.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Flattering fit! breathable fabric good for all seasons of professional travel

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love origami tech for travel. And it has pockets! Easy yet professional.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Loved this dress and excited to wear it. Flattering but modest cut. Ordered in size 16 and fit well in the shoulders and chest even on my busty frame. The everyday crepe fabric is stretchy and light but still feels substantial. Not a fan on the contrasting topstitch, but the black is still professional.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: What a great fit and look! Love the color!

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Beautifully made. Simple and easy to wear. Very professional looking.

product_name: Meghan Midi Skirt - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I liked this skirt so much! I got it with the matching tie-neck blouse and they look as chic together as they do in the pictures. The slit down the front is flattering and sexy, but not too sexy considering the midi length of the skirt. That's kind of the sweet spot I am going for with my office attire! I deducted one star because while I had to purchase a Size 4 to fit my hips, it gapped quite a bit around my waist. This is normal for me - I have a big butt! and a comparatively small waist - but I usually don't experience this issue with MM clothes. I still kept the skirt because it is beautiful and I got it on sale.

product_name: Meghan Midi Skirt - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love everything about this skirt! The shape and front slit are perfect, and the top-stitching makes it a great match paired with my Frankie.

product_name: Sedgwick Belt - Suede :: Black
review_text: I can use this for so many winter occasions. Good investment piece.

product_name: Sedgwick Belt - Suede :: Black
review_text: The belt looks nice. No vanity sizing. I needed to get a large (usually medium else where)

product_name: Sedgwick Belt - Suede :: Black
review_text: I've worn this a few times and it's a nice width for me - not too wide, not too narrow. It matches black suede shoes that I have and completes the outfit!

product_name: Beebe Belt :: Tan
review_text: Nicely made and true to size- I wear an 8 in pants/dresses and a 6 in tops and bought this waist belt in a medium to cinch in dresses and blazers. Would have preferred the belt if it was slightly narrower and perhaps with gold or black hardware for the black leather option.

product_name: Beebe Belt :: Tan
review_text: On the smaller side.

product_name: Beebe Belt :: Tan
review_title: Beautiful Belt with Size Chart that could be improved with more details
review_text:
Gorgeous belt. The back of it was very smooth--something that another review had me worried about. I have a 30" waist on my ideal days. I had to put this on the very largest hole to wear comfortably. Second hole in was corset-ish. I agonized over whether to choose M or L when ordering. I guess I should have tried L? I returned because if I am bloated in anyway this would not work and sometimes those are exactly the days you would want to suck in/cover with a wide belt. 

I wish the size chart gave the length of the belt and the hole positions, as it would have made my choices more obvious with my tape measure at home.

product_name: Beebe Belt :: Tan
review_text: Great belt...just the right width and very well made. This is my first order with M.M. Lafleur and won't be the last.

product_name: Beebe Belt :: Tan
review_text: The belt looked nice. Had to exchange for a different size.

product_name: Garrett Belt :: Black
review_text: Love this. I wear it with dresses and pants. Recently paired with black etsuko dress and created a nice tone on tone look.

product_name: Garrett Belt :: Black
review_title: If you’re not a belt wearer this could be your belt
review_text: I dont wear belts but love this- it has stretch ( but doesn’t look like a stretch belt) so it fits well, doesn’t ride up or gap. I purchased this to add polish to outfits as I return to work after lockdown and will incorporate it into many outfits.

product_name: Garrett Belt :: Black
review_text: I got the XXL, my usual size with MM Lafleur, and while it technically fit, it could have been longer. Which would allow for more options in terms of ways to wear it. The body of the belt does not appear to be leather, just the covered buckle and tip. I do like a covered buckle. But it is a nice quality and very comfortable because of the stretch.

product_name: Garrett Belt :: Black
review_text: Most belts are too big on me but this one adjusts regardless. Why not make this in red?

product_name: Garrett Belt :: Black
review_text: Since there are no holes, the blet can be worn at any point along the belt. Although it is leather, it is stretchy.

product_name: Wide Stitched Belt :: Black
review_text: Love the belt! I did order a medium and was shocked that I had to exchange it for a large. It definitely runs small. Quality is terrific.

product_name: Wide Stitched Belt :: Black
review_text: Evelvates many dresses. Very versatile

product_name: Wide Stitched Belt :: Black
review_text: Love this belt. Runs a bit small but it’s so elegant and flattering.

product_name: Wide Stitched Belt :: Black
review_text: Love the dress. I love the belt, but I am so short-waisted that it doesn't look good on me.

product_name: Wide Stitched Belt :: Black
review_text: I bought this in XS, which is my normal size, and it fit me fine. I wondered about going for the S, but I do have a pretty small waist so the XS was a good choice. One thing about this belt is that it only has three holes. anyway, I have worn this several times and I am really enjoying it!

product_name: Wide Strap Belt :: Black
review_text: Fits well. True to size chart. Well made. Wish I had bought the brown, too.

product_name: Wide Strap Belt :: Black
review_text: Soft, flexible but sturdy leather. Just what I was hoping for in a quality belt so hard to find in ladies fashion. Why do men seem to get the only real leather belts these days? Shipped with care. Metal buckle protected with special wrapping. Matches my loafers perfectly! Great buy. Will be a forever piece.

product_name: Wide Strap Belt :: Black
review_text: Good quality but runs really small. I have a small waste at first small barely fit.

product_name: Wide Strap Belt :: Black
review_text: This belt has quickly become my go-to belt. It looks great with jeans and all of my many pairs of the Meja pant. The color is rich and works with all other colors and shades. The belt is true to size.

product_name: Wide Strap Belt :: Black
review_text: Perfect belt for pants, or for belting a dress or sweater!

product_name: Desk Blotter - Leather :: Caramel
review_text: So beautiful! Great quality

product_name: Pen Holder - Leather :: Caramel
review_text: Better than expected so absolutely beautiful

product_name: Passport Holder - Kidskin :: Deep Green
review_text: High quality leather and nice design. The interior pockets accommodate the passport, receipts and slots for credit cards. It's beautiful and functional — everything I expect from MM.

product_name: Passport Holder - Kidskin :: Deep Green
review_text: Just the best fit for carrying important travel and identification documents - a forever home to protect my passport, identity cards, cash and other papers and makes it a breeze carrying everything in one compact holder. Love the classic design and sophisticated look, appreciate the cloth bag it comes in to also protect the material of the holder itself. A long-lasting quality purchase, this one!

product_name: Ribbed Cashmere Socks :: Heather Gray

product_name: Ribbed Cashmere Socks :: Heather Gray

product_name: Circle Cable Gloves - Cashmere :: Chianti
review_text: I love these cashmere gloves. I've never had gloves that are this long before, but they fit very nicely and keep my entire hand and wrist warm.

product_name: Packable Bag Big - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I like the packable bag. On the rare occasions where I travel these days, this bag keeps outfits organized.
